reviews.author: Lydia Troche
reviews.text: The employees gave the menu and had us sit to only have us order our food at the register. The presentation of the food was nice. Taste of the food could’ve had more seasoning. Cleanliness could’ve been better. Then the restroom has no changing table for babies.

reviews.author: Marleen García
reviews.text: The food here is absolutely delicious, and the Guatemalan bread is amazing! 🥖 Everything is so fresh and flavorful. The workers are incredibly friendly and welcoming, and the cook is truly the best! Highly recommend this place! ❤️

reviews.author: Sheryl Diaz
reviews.text: The food was actually delicious! It's honestly up there just below my mom's Guatemalan cooking. Flavorful, cooked to order and decent portions. Ppl that think a certain other well know Guatemalan bakery has good food, have no idea what they are missing out on from Guatepan. Don't expect table service though. Reasonable prices! Bread was fresh and warm.

reviews.author: Ogy Reiusch
reviews.text: Good food, especially the breakfast! The bread is just so small! I wish they had bigger portions sometimes. Still a lovely and cozy place to have morning breakfast.

reviews.author: Jonnathan Samayoa Godoy

reviews.text: well it's Thursday, Oct 23, 4:20 pm and it's currently closed with no sign to why its closed or whatsoever.

reviews.author: Frances Yau

The toppings and sauce were balanced well. We got the margherita and pesto chicken, both of which were delicious. Service was quick and friendly; price was awesome. Definitely will go again!

reviews.author: Elina Khoshnevis
reviews.text:
Genuinely some of the best pizza I’ve had in all of LA! First of all, the two gentlemen working there were incredibly kind, welcoming, and courteous.

reviews.author: Bruce
reviews.text:
Had Guerreros like 3-4 times now and it’s seriously the best.
An unassuming tent with a real wood fire oven cooking up some of the best pizza in LA.
I’ve tried the Garlic cloud, margarita, pepperoni, burrata, but the one that stands out is their birria pizza. Seriously amazing pizza with crispy crusts and loads of flavor.
Come give Guerreros a try

reviews.author: Juan Moreno

Very good pizzas next to the USC Village. Prices are decent and the quality is great.

Service isn’t the quickest but that’s just because there’s usually a lot of people ordering.

reviews.author: M.M. Martin

I expected soft, warm, fresh handmade tortilla

The 10$ entrance fee is highway robbery honestly, and I bought the year pass instead.

Our trusty ktown salon! She never misses!!!
It's always a peaceful relaxing quiet vibe. We absolutely love the owner - she's super sweet. From hair cuts to perms, she's given my husband and I hairstyles that understands our wants and references AND styles it in a way that flatters our face shapes. She also gave my husband tips and product to help style his hair well.

reviews.author: Janet JuYoung Kang
reviews.text:
Good news!
If you have thin hair try this perm. At the salon,this perm is called Ringer Perm, but I would like to say that it is a Botox perm. I am very satisfied with this perm. When I wake up, I can see the hair whorl, but after brushing after this perm, I can’t see the hair whorl, so I ‘m so so happy 😃💕💕💕

reviews.text: Amazing she was the sweetest they even gave my mom a free coffee powder cuz the coffee was amazing and delicious I really love how she didn’t even need to see the video to cut my hair she knew professionally how to cut it.

reviews.author: Isaac Katten
reviews.text: The owner does a great job and puts a lot of care into her work. I am a guy and get a fairly basic, professional haircut and she still spends a good amount of time ensuring my hair is well balanced and stylish. I pay $30 (excluding tip) and am extremely satisfied.

reviews.author: Madeleine Dile
reviews.text: I've been there twice and had a great experience! It's a very quiet salon, the hairdressers are very nice, and they were able to replicate the picture I brought in almost exactly. It's $40 for a women's hair cut, and definitely worth it!

reviews.author: Rebecca Yerly
reviews.text: This place is fabulous!  Pinky and all the ladies make you feel so welcome and are really expert at sizing you up and bringing flattering beautiful clothes to you that look great on. The conversation is great, too, and it feels so good to support a woman owned business. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: A. Cherise Alley
reviews.text: Exceptional customer service, welcoming atmosphere, unique stylish apparel only in 2-3 per style, so I don't worry about seeing someone else with my frock on, always one of a kind!

reviews.author: Samm Riva
reviews.text: My absolute must go to place when I come to LA. Best boutique I have shopped at in a long time. They have the greatest gifts, beautiful clothes, and such an incredible staff. My entire closet is their line and I get so many compliments everyday. I'm so happy to have found this beautiful boutique.  If you are in LA or ever visiting this is a must-do!!!

reviews.author: DBM Channel
reviews.text: I discovered this boutique yesterday and I purchased  2 items from the clearance rack and they feel so luxurious. The blouse is flowy and the pants fit perfectly. The clothing is beautiful as well as the designer’s personality. I can say Pinky Rose’s clothing fits my style. I will be back.

reviews.author: Kenny Lyon
reviews.text: A great place to buy gifts (even if that someone is yourself) on burgeoning Pico Boulevard. The owner and staff are incredible, friendly enough that you'd just like to hang out there. The clothing/accessories/what-have-you stock is eclectic, but always informed by a unique sense of style.

reviews.author: Kairui Zhang
reviews.text: Really happy with my Takashi Murakami print from Pinto Gallery. The team was helpful throughout the purchase, and everything arrived well packaged and in excellent condition. The print is beautiful in person—a wonderful addition to my collection.

reviews.author: Rock Kessler
reviews.text: Pinto Gallery have the most colorful art pieces. As a modern fashion style gallery in 2024, they did an excellent job presenting those mind blowing collections in front of us.

reviews.author: Giacomo
reviews.text:
Selling works that, at the time of listing, had not yet been officially released or allocated is highly questionable.

The four Murakami edition prints, released for the Brooklyn Museum and scheduled to be allocated via draw on May 27, were listed (beginning of May) at around $6,800, while the primary price is about €870 — a markup of roughly 600–700%.

“We believe collecting art should be more ap

reviews.author: Leif Mealone
reviews.text: The gallery was great to deal with!  Professional and detailed oriented. They ensured the entire transaction went smoothly, making me more than comfortable with my purchase. They handled all aspects of purchase from framing to shipping. I would highly recommend them to anyone in the market for art.

reviews.author: Jonathan Choi
reviews.text: I visited Pinto Gallery's booth at the Art San Diego 2024 Fair for the first time and was extremely impressed to say the very least. An amazing representation of Takashi Murakami's work with such a unique selection of pieces to fit one's taste. Peric and Evelyn were extremely helpful and sweet throughout the whole process. Looking forward to seeing them in more shows!

reviews.author: Alicia
reviews.text: It pains me to say it but this library is not great. No parking, sketchy people loitering outside it. Self checkout is always broken leaving you to deal with an aggressively rude librarian. Wish they'd can him already. Ktown deserves better than this. If you want a good library experience, skip this one.

reviews.author: Nicholas Cafarelli
reviews.text:
Maker Lab, conference rooms, photo rooms, streaming facilities, computers, and much much more. Parking lot 2 hours for free, $1 per hour. Fill your brain until it stretches your skull.  Enjoy.

They continue to excavate and it looks like the library will be twice as large when they're done.

reviews.author: Laura Escobar
reviews.text: The library employees are really friendly and great! This place just needs a major facelift and renovation. I hope that LAPL has plans to make this a project.

Place was under construction.
It is hard to find the entrance.  ONLY street parking available.
The homeless factor is heavy and the patrons are inconsiderate.
There are no study rooms.
Horrible place to study.

reviews.author: Judy
reviews.text:
Staff members are friendly and helpful.
There are lots of books and programs.
You have to park your car on street parking.
I wish pio pico library has thier own parking lot for visitors instead of street parking.
overall easy access, clean and nice library in Korea town. :)

reviews.author: William Fong
reviews.text:
For the happy hour, it’s a super deal.  We ordered boneless buffalo chicken, spaghetti bolognese, and Honey Bear 🍕 pizza.

The buffalo chicken was juicy and meaty.  The sauce was not too spicy or drenched.

The spaghetti noodle was a bit soft and the sauce was ok.

The pizza was great for the price.

We were there at 330 pm and the place was on the HOT side .

reviews.author: Mary Belles
reviews.text: Best Pitfire in the chain by far.  The best Happy Hour EVERY DAY - including holidays like the 4th.  Great deals on great pizza and ALL the drafts— not just the certain selections someone else chose. They always let me bring my bike onto the patio so I don’t have to worry about it.  It’s a perfect atmosphere for any afternoon break.  They also have a lot of vegetarian choices, like this….

reviews.author: Abdulaziz Abdurakhmanov
reviews.text: Really enjoyed Pitfire Artisan Pizza! The pizza was fresh and flavorful with a great crust, and the creamy pasta with mushrooms was really good too. Everything came out fresh and the portions were generous. Nice casual atmosphere and a great spot to come with friends or family. Definitely coming back!

reviews.author: Matthew Combs
reviews.text:
Got in to LA and wanted some dinner after a very long trip, and gave this place a shot via delivery. I ordered the sausage party pizza and it’s quite literally my favorite pizza I’ve ever had delivered to me.
The prices are exceptional given the area, and the pizza itself is just amazing. We don’t have this good back home in the Midwest and that’s truly a shame.

reviews.author: Edith Guerrero
reviews.text: The pizza is delicious! We also had the buffalo boneless chicken and they were amazing! Everything tastes fresh and homemade. Staff is very helpful and kind. It’s very spacious and family friendly.

reviews.text: Some of if not the best pizza in LA. They add cheese on top of their toppings and it gives your pizza a different but familiar flavor. The house special is a must try! I've been coming here for years and the flavor is still just as great. If you’re in the area and want pizza this is an absolute perfect option.

properties.name: 화연 Hwayeon Korean BBQ Restaurant
properties.address: 863 S Western Ave, Los Angeles, CA 90005

reviews.author: Lenandjenn
reviews.text: This was our first time visiting this Korean BBQ spot in Koreatown during a trip to Los Angeles last week, and it turned out to be an incredible find! We originally planned to dine at a restaurant a few doors down, but since they were completely full, we decided to give this place a chance based on their strong online reviews. I only wish they had a location back home in Toronto so we could visit

reviews.author: travis travis
reviews.text: Great tasting beef & pork! The salad and side dishes are also excellent tasting.  The Server was great and staff all friendly.  Great price for quality and service provided.  Thank you guys!  See you next time.

reviews.author: Tommy Lei
reviews.text: It was so good. Everything from the meats, sides, and soups were made so well. It tasted high quality and made with care. I came 4 days ago and I had to come back a second time!

reviews.author: Cindy Moon
reviews.text:
I was there for a dinner and i was surprised about their price and meat qualities
It is very delicious and meats are very juicy
I highly recommend you guys should try it as well

reviews.author: Aimee
reviews.text: Did a meet up here, and what a great experience! The food was outstanding.  They came by frequently to check on us, check on the meat, and serve items. We ordered the combo, and it had a good amount for four of us. It is located in Western Plaza, decent amount of parking, and close to other Ktown places.

reviews.author: Shani Shahmoon
reviews.text: I had a really pleasant experience here! Lilli was kind, had great energy, and did a wonderful job with both my haircut and color. While I initially had some frustration with the payment process, the salon was quick to reach out and address my concerns. I really appreciated their responsiveness and willingness to make things right. Overall, a positive experience!

reviews.author: Jessica Arce
reviews.text: I’ve been coming here for a while, and I can honestly say this is the best hair salon in Los Angeles! The entire team is incredibly attentive and welcoming, especially Sophie, the owner. She’s pure magic and always works her magic on my hair! I leave loving my results every time, and I know you will too. Highly recommend! ✨
